name: apitools
description: A local-first REST API debugger (Rust + Tauri) with import/export and MCP support

scripts.build:mcp: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin apitools-mcp && node scripts/copy-mcp.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:mcp && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:mcp && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
